body:
Phase-3 enforcement skeletons per SPEC line 168 (2026-04-28 decisions-log enforcement-skeleton-rollout entry). Three sub-tasks; (c) is Phase-6 deferred per the spec.

(a) scripts/fw replay <seed> — minimal compare against checked-in canonical-state fixture. Run MatchSimulationRunner with fixture-specified archetypes + tick count + compute MatchCanonicalState hash + compare against expected hash. Exit 0 on match; non-zero with diff on mismatch. First fixture: MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xdeadbeefdeadbeef.json containing matchSeed + tickCount + homeArchetype + awayArchetype + expectedCanonicalHash (the pinned 60-tick smoke fixture hash sha256:7e851976...50e at tick 60 with direct-pressing vs low-block-counter; matches MatchDeterminismTests.cs).

(b) scripts/fw save-migration-test stub. Empty fixtures dir + Phase-4 trigger when MemoryEvent ships. Subcommand exits 0 when MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/save-migration/ has no fixtures. Already wired into fw verify per STATUS — confirm it stays integrated.

(c) Content-pack validator skeleton — DEFERRED to Phase 6. Out of scope for this task.

acceptance:
- scripts/fw replay 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef exits 0; canonical hash matches fixture.
- scripts/fw replay 0xbad0000000000bad (synthetic) exits 0 if fixture exists with that seed; OR exits non-zero with "fixture not found" message if not — fixture-not-found is a defined non-zero state, not a crash.
- MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xdeadbeefdeadbeef.json exists with schema {matchSeed, homeArchetype, awayArchetype, tickCount, expectedCanonicalHash}.
- scripts/fw save-migration-test stays integrated in fw verify; exits 0 with no-fixtures message.
- scripts/fw verify Tier-A umbrella GREEN.
- MatchSim 644/644 UNCHANGED; pinned 60-tick hash UNCHANGED; no MatchSim source touched.
- New tests (if any) under MatchSim.Tests/** stay green.

files_in_scope:
- scripts/fw
- MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/**
- MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/save-migration/**
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/** (only if a new fixture-loader test is needed)

files_out_of_scope:
- MatchSim/** (NO canonical-state-bearing source changes; pinned hash MUST stay)
- design/**.md / SPEC.md / CLAUDE.md / TECH_APPROACH.md / TOOLING.md / PROJECT_CONTEXT.md / SETUP.md
- .claude/agents/** / .claude/rules/** / .claude/hooks/**
- unity-project/**
- dialog/** (other than the active topic JSONL)

max_tokens: 200000
max_wall_clock_seconds: 5400
max_turns: 30

escalation_triggers: out-of-scope file / Unity_AssetGeneration_* / canonical-hash drift / fw verify red 2x / SPEC|design mutation / 3+ counter deadlock / 80% budget / cascade-check exit 4 / MatchSim/** source change attempt.

implementing_agent: claude; reviewing_agent: codex.

depends_on: none. Builds on SPEC line 168 (2026-04-28 decisions-log) + the existing scripts/fw subcommand framework + the MatchCanonicalState encoder shipped 2026-04-27.

LoC est ~150-250 (bash subcommand handlers + small fixture JSON files + optional MatchSim.Tests fixture loader). Reviewer-gate-before-commit per ADR-0012 §C2.

Task closed — no implementation work needed. Pre-flight check confirms the deliverables already exist on main: (a) scripts/fw replay <seed> --compare-corpus subcommand implemented + MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xdeadbeefdeadbeef.json shipped (corpus_schema_version=1; expected.final_canonical_state_hash matches the pinned 60-tick smoke fixture sha256:7e851976...50e; runs end-to-end + 2 tests pass in 46ms). (b) scripts/fw save-migration-test stub implemented + integrated into fw verify umbrella (no fixtures present → 'OK: no save-migration fixtures yet (Phase-4 trigger when MemoryEvent ships)'). (c) Content-pack validator skeleton stays Phase-6 deferred as expected. Acceptance bullets all green: fw replay 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef --compare-corpus exits 0; fixture exists with correct schema; save-migration-test integrated + exits 0; fw verify GREEN; MatchSim 644/644 UNCHANGED; pinned hash UNCHANGED. SPEC line 168 + line 175 still marked [ ] — flipping both [x] in a sibling bookkeeping commit since SPEC.md is out-of-scope per this task-spec. No agent-bus reviewer cycle needed (no code changes); user can override if a Codex review pass is wanted.
